{{Location disambiguation 2}} {{mission-stub}} {{Mission infobox | name = Scarred Psyche | campaign = Halloween | region = The Mists | type = Challenge | duration = 30 minutes }} [[Scarred Psyche]] is a [[challenge mission]] during [[Halloween]]. ==Mission information== ===Objective=== *Kill five generals to force Palawa Joko to appear then defeat Palawa himself. === Reward === [[File:Scarred Psyche mission loading screen.jpg|250px|thumb|Loading screen]] This mission rewards [[Trick-or-Treat Bag]]s, [[Gold]] and [[Gamer|Gamer Points]] based on the formula below. Values are rounded down. Additional bonuses are awarded for beating the daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best scores. {| style="margin: 0 0 0.5em 1em; border: solid 1px silver; text-align: center; font-size: 90%" cellpadding="4" |- style="background: #7BC; font-size: 120%" ! Reward || Amount || Daily Best || Monthly Best || Base Reward |- ! style="background: #7BC;" | ToT Bags | (30 * score) / (Monthly Best #1 score) || +10 || +20 || 10 |- ! style="background: #7BC;" | Gamer Points | (15 * score) / (Monthly Best #1 score) || +5 || +10 || 5 |- ! style="background: #7BC;" | Gold | (1000 * score) / (Monthly Best #1 score) || +500 || +1000 || 0 |} ==Walkthrough== During this mission, you're under the disguise of [[Candy Corn Infantry]] and have 600 Health, 50 Energy and the following skills: {{skill bar|Candy Corn Strike|Rocket-Propelled Gobstopper|Feast of Vengeance|Rain of Terror (spell)|Cry of Madness|Sugar Infusion|Animate Candy Golem|Resurrection Signet|}} The main goal is to kill five of Joko's generals to force Joko to come out and fight, who you must then defeat. There are twelve bosses in the map at first; six generals and six priests. Each general will be accompanied by a priest and six guard NPCs. The priests do not need to be killed nor does the last general. Once you kill five generals, Palawa Joko will spawn at the location of the sixth general - bringing his health down to about 25% will complete the mission. When entering the mission, leave the starting area through any of the three doors. Defeat the first wave then continue to either side and kill the two generals (which generals you kill first doesn't matter) - ignore the priest and the guards if possible, as you can save time by simply breaking aggro. When both generals down that path are dead, return to the center, kill off any foes, then go down another path and kill the two generals, once more returning to kill any foes in the center before going down the third path. After killing the fifth general, quickly return to Thorn as he and his group will head towards you and can become body-blocked and unresponsive by spawns (who may have a chance to kill Thorn because of this). Once Thorn is with you, head to where the sixth general is and focus fire on Joko - killing the last general isn't necessary. ;Map

Go on, start ruing!"'' :'''Palawa Joko''': ''"This is not the end of Palawa Joko!"'' ==Notes== *Deaths do not cause [[Death Penalty]] or count against the [[Survivor]] title track. *Every 2 minutes your party and Candy Corn Infantry are resurrected in the center of the map and Priests of Joko that are alive will resurrect their respective group of guards. *Only the guards and bosses give [[drop]]s and [[experience]]. Among the drops are [[Glob of Ectoplasm|Globs of Ectoplasm]]. *This map uses a Halloween-modified version of [[Scarred Earth]]. *Your team starts with 1,800 points, and loses 1 point per second until Palawa Joko is defeated. After 30 minutes, when the points run out, your team is automatically defeated. *This and [[Mad King's Fan]] are the only non-[[PvP]] methods to get [[Gamer]] points. {{anomaly|When Thorn and Joko speak, a face will not appear in the dialogue box, even if they are within radar distance.}} {{anomaly|The [[Mission Map]] is blank.}} == Trivia == * This mission was first added during [[Halloween 2011]]. * Thorn's response to Palawa's threat after his defeat is a reference to Palawa's threat at the end of [[Open the Flood Gates of Death]], which in turn was a reference to Palawa conquering [[Elona]] between ''[[Guild Wars]]'' and ''[[Guild Wars 2]]''. * "You'll see!
